scoring_justification: Recomputing full GCMC simulations is infeasible in the verifier sandbox. Comparison of reported aggregates to paper‑derived structural and quantitative criteria is employed.

outputs.description: Simulated adsorption isotherms for all zeolite models. The hidden checker compares loading values to paper‑reported gold with tolerances and performs structural checks (sub‑step presence/absence).
Isosteric heat of adsorption curves for all zeolite models. The hidden checker compares heat values at specified loadings to paper‑reported trends.

output_contract.notes: The CSV files must contain rows for all model identifiers listed in the step descriptions. The checker validates the reported loading and heat values, as well as qualitative features (sub‑step detection, monotonicity) against hidden reference data derived from the paper.

steps.description: Checks model coverage, loading monotonicity, and sub-step presence (Nicholas_mod_flex) vs absence (Demontis_mod_flex) in the 28-40 molecules/uc window.
Checks model coverage and isosteric heat trends: rigid heat decrease after 24 molecules/uc, Demontis_mod_flex plateau then drop near 31 molecules/uc.
